about: Fifth picture pass for the hauntings documentary (fetch.py --extra, Oct. 21, 2026): a full-size cut-out of the earliest version of the 1905 headless-ghost story we found, "Ghost Causes a Panic," in The Virginia Enterprise (Virginia, Minn.), July 7, 1905, from the Library of Congress. Same rules: public domain, CC0 or CC BY only.
